title: Xerjoff 12-Day Advent Calendar
body:
Xerjoff is turning the 2026 festive period into a true luxury experience with its very first Advent calendar. This 12-day calendar has been conceived as a precious ritual, an invitation to savour the beauty of anticipation and explore each of its nuances with intention.

Opening each door and discovering the gift that lies behind it, the recipient takes one step further into the Xerjoff universe, immersing themselves in a world of creativity and artistic expression. Going beyond perfumery, the calendar also includes luxury beauty products, scented candles, decorative ornaments for the festive season and a book that recounts the essence of Xerjoff and the philosophy of its founder, Sergio Momo.

The countdown to Christmas culminates with the grand finale, a 50ml flacon of Primi Venti, a brand new perfume created exclusively for this Advent calendar.

title: Wonderland Carousel
body:
A curated seven-day luxury experience designed to enrich the festive season, the Wonderland Carousel is Casamorati's first ever Advent calendar.

The Wonderland Carousel draws inspiration from the carousel fairground ride and the dreamlike atmosphere that it creates through a mesmerising blend of music, motion and fantasy. In the same fashion, this Advent calendar takes the recipient on a journey of sensory exploration through the enchanting world of Casamorati, where artistic inspiration is transformed into olfactory excellence and beauty always prevails.

The magic of Italian niche perfumery is presented across seven days of scented gifts, including Melodica, a new, exclusive perfume created specifically for inclusion in the Wonderland Carousel. Behind each door of the calendar lies a new sensation, waiting to be lived.

title: Tony Iommi Deified Signed Edition
body:
Tony Iommi Deified is the second chapter of the collaboration between Black Sabbath’s legendary guitarist and rock composer, Tony Iommi, and Xerjoff founder, Sergio Momo. This special limited edition flacon has been hand-signed by Tony Iommi himself.

Playing on the phenomenon of palindromes in sound, scent and sensorial sequences, Tony Iommi Deified plays in a loop with no beginning and no end, accompanying the wearer with its omnipresent aura.

title: Louis XV 1722 Deodorant Spray
body:
In a combination of luxury and practicality, the crisp, champagne-inspired scent of Louis XV 1722 is the latest Xerjoff perfume to be transformed into a deodorant spray. Maintaining the refined character and scent of the original perfume, the Louis XV 1722 deodorant spray adds luxurious, long-lasting protection to the olfactory experience.

The pump spray design delivers a surge of freshness in the form of a fine mist, giving you  and is considerate of even the most sensitive skin.

title: Uden Deodorant Spray
body:
Discover a new dimension of Uden with this refined deodorant spray, a blend of luxury and practicality that brings the invigorating spirit of the original eau de parfum into your daily ritual. Its sophisticated formula offers the alluring scent of Uden in a form designed for modern, effortless freshness.

The pump spray design of the deodorant is considerate of even the most sensitive skin, delivering a zesty surge of revitalising energy in the form of a fine mist.

title: Emery
body:
Emery is a flower garden in full bloom, with a bounty of beautiful rose bushes at its heart. Walking down its winding path, taking in the colours as you go, the dew glistens brightest on the rose petals.

There is a gracefulness to Emery befitting its opulent floral composition. This is a delicate, refined perfume that evolves on the skin, revealing the full richness of its character as the hours go by.

title: Avanguardia
body:
Avanguardia is ahead of its time. Full of conviction and unbothered by common consensus, it is a trailblazing perfume that forges its own path. A strong, clearly-defined idea that has taken its final form — one that is unexpected and visionary.

Avanguardia operates on a higher level than most, unbound by the constraints of convention. Born from an innovative spirit shared by Xerjoff and Lamborghini, it is a perfume that dares to go beyond.

title: Perseveranza
body:
Perseveranza embodies quiet determination. It does not shout or draw attention to what it is doing. Instead, it works calmly and consistently towards achieving its goals. It is not the flame that burns the brightest, but the one that never goes out.

The disarmingly discreet character of Perseveranza masks a steely resolve embedded deep within its soul. It is bright and liberating, unburdened by the weight of the challenge and capable of overcoming any obstacle.

title: Fierezza
body:
The name Fierezza represents everything Lamborghini has to be proud of, from its engineering prowess and craftsmanship, to its design philosophy and Italian identity. This is a perfume that rightly swells with pride.

Its dignified sense of self-worth is born from its authenticity, the originality of its composition and the honest, justified recognition of its own beauty. Fierezza stands tall, confident in itself and its abilities. It is a scent that commands respect, doing so with taste, poise and elegance.

title: Naxos Gift Set
body:
Steeped in heritage but with a contemporary twist, Naxos is an uplifting and inspiring scent that transports the wearer to the island of Sicily.

A classically Italian scent, Naxos opens with fresh and exhilarating citrus notes, leading to a warm and embracing heart that leaves the senses longing for more.

The Naxos Gift Set includes a 170 g scented candle from the Scentimento collection, NoirDeNoir, whose gentle aroma and soft glow are perfect for setting an intimate atmosphere.

title: Louis XV 1722 Gift Set
body:
A fusion of tradition, passion and artisanal expertise, Louis XV 1722 is the result of Xerjoff’s artistic exploration with Maison de Venoge, one of France’s most prestigious Champagne houses.

Metallic accents are present in the opening of this irresistible, amber woody composition, mirroring the effervescent sensation that champagne instils in the senses. A majestic blend of fruity and floral notes gives Louis XV 1722 a crispness, with a warm, cultivated base befitting its prestige.

The Louis XV 1722 Gift Set includes a 170 g scented candle from the Scentimento collection, TabacDoré, whose gentle aroma and soft glow are perfect for setting an intimate atmosphere.

title: Tony Iommi Monkey Special Gift Set
body:
In Tony Iommi Monkey Special, the legendary guitarist’s musical talent and artistic sensibilities are conveyed through an alternative prism, expressing what rock 'n' roll in the late '60s was for him through the medium of scent.

Fresh Calabrian bergamot meets rum in the opening for an early element of rockstar appeal and the warmth of leather reverberates throughout. Caramel, sandalwood and vanilla provide the smooth, solid grounding — and a touch of sweetness — that gives this scent its commanding, powerful character.

The Tony Iommi Monkey Special Gift Set includes a 170 g scented candle from the Scentimento collection, BellaNotte, whose gentle aroma and soft glow are perfect for setting an intimate atmosphere.

title: Erba Pura Gift Set
body:
Erba Pura is a contemporary perfume with a bright character, traditional roots and an enticing, fruity sweetness.

Opening with top notes of Sicilian orange and Calabrian bergamot, Erba Pura bears an undeniably Italian influence. More fruity notes from the Mediterranean lie at its heart, making it an enduringly fresh scent, grounded by smooth vanilla, white musk and amber.

The Erba Pura Gift Set includes a 170 g scented candle from the Scentimento collection, BellaNotte, whose gentle aroma and soft glow are perfect for setting an intimate atmosphere.

title: TORINO21 Gift Set
body:
TORINO21 is a fresh, revitalising scent that combines the artistry of perfumery with the excitement of professional sport, preserving the emotion that each evokes.

It bursts into life from the very first spray and calls the senses to attention with citrus and aromatic accents, as its clean base provides a solid grounding.

The TORINO21 Gift Set includes a 170 g scented candle from the Scentimento collection, LunaLovers, whose gentle aroma and soft glow are perfect for setting an intimate atmosphere.

title: TORINO25 Gift Set
body:
Xerjoff has a deep connection to the sport of tennis. Tapping into that connection, the elegant and sophisticated scent of TORINO25 captures the essence of celebration, evoking the emotion of the winner’s trophy lift. This perfume is the olfactory embodiment of grace and pure elation — and the crowning achievement of a glorious legacy.

TORINO25 opens with playful top notes of saffron and rhubarb, accompanied by exhilarating nuances of grapefruit and fresh ginger. Sophisticated notes of leather and juniper are nestled alongside smooth suede, creating a luxurious contexture that balances energy and elegance.

The TORINO25 Gift Set includes a 170 g scented candle from the Scentimento collection, TrueBlue, whose gentle aroma and soft glow are perfect for setting an intimate atmosphere.

title: Gibeon Gift Set
body:
Through its dreamlike, ethereal scent, Gibeon reflects the mystique of its meteorite namesake. The soft powderiness of neroli, a quality amplified by the heart note of Tuscan orris, defines the composition with its luxurious, velvety caress. Gibeon’s enduring smoothness comes from its Madagascan vanilla and tonka bean pairing, with clean musk and the warm, balsamic nuances of cedarwood at the base.

The Gibeon Gift Set includes a 170 g scented candle from the Scentimento collection, BlancDeNoir, whose gentle aroma and soft glow are perfect for setting an intimate atmosphere.

title: Alexandria II Gift Set
body:
Inspired by the ancient Arabian art of perfumery, Alexandria II captures the essence of the city that has long been a crossroads of cultures, history and trade, blending timeless elegance with a fresh, lively spirit.

It opens with intriguing notes of apple intertwined with lavender and rosewood, unfolding into a classic oriental heart of cedarwood, lily of the valley and Bulgarian rose. Alexandria II concludes with warm, woody base notes of amber, sandalwood and precious Laotian oud.

The Alexandria II Gift Set includes a 170 g scented candle from the Scentimento collection, NoirDeNoir, whose gentle aroma and soft glow are perfect for setting an intimate atmosphere.

title: Erba Gold Gift Set
body:
With its enticing tropical sweetness, Erba Gold gives off a playful, vibrant and magnetic energy. Erba Gold opens to citrus notes and delicious green apple, followed closely by sweet melon at its heart. Cloves, cardamom and cinnamon add an element of spice, and the warmth of amber, vanilla and woody notes at the base give Erba Gold a rich depth.

The Erba Gold Gift Set includes a 170 g scented candle from the Scentimento collection, TabacDoré, whose gentle aroma and soft glow are perfect for setting an intimate atmosphere.

title: 40 Knots Gift Set
body:
Taking its inspiration from the exclusive yacht club lifestyle, 40 Knots brings you aboard a sailboat gliding across the mesmerising Mediterranean sea.

The salty spray in the air, the beauty of the sun’s rays glistening on the turquoise waters and the taste of freedom that comes from the open water — all captured in this highly evocative perfume.

The 40 Knots Gift Set includes a 170 g scented candle from the Scentimento collection, BlancDeNoir, whose gentle aroma and soft glow are perfect for setting an intimate atmosphere.

title: Newcleus
body:
Newcleus pushes the boundaries of traditional perfumery. Rather than the typical liquid format, Newcleus sees the perfume encapsulated within alginate spheres. These delicate capsules release their scent only upon contact with the skin, gently bursting to unveil an enchanting perfume experience.

Newcleus offers a soothing sensation that nourishes both skin and senses, no matter how sensitive.

title: Six
body:
This product is available exclusively at the Xerjoff Dubai boutique.

The smoky, spicy scent of perfume Six is deliberately reminiscent of a staple of Middle Eastern culture that dates back thousands of years: bakhoor. A type of incense, bakhoor has been burned in the region for millennia, and over time has become associated with luxury and hospitality — much like the UAE itself.

Taking inspiration from the country’s national flag, Six is housed in a black flacon. The hand-painted brushstroke finish mimics the moving sands of the desert, symbolising the constant evolution of the UAE.

title: Tempio d'Acqua
body:
In the hills not far from Parma, Italy, lies a natural spa that is a masterpiece of architecture. It was designed to connect man with the healing properties of nature — and to serve as a reminder of her abundant beauty.

Depictions of blooming flora and fauna interspersed with Greek goddesses adorn the interior walls in a harmonious fusion of Art Nouveau, Art Deco and Far Eastern influences. Vibrantly-coloured stained glass windows filter the sunlight and intricate floral motifs add an extra dimension of tranquility to the already relaxing environment.

The spa’s ability to immerse visitors in the beauty of nature — both physically and visually — while offering a sensory escape is the inspiration behind Tempio d’Acqua. A perfume that instantly sparks a sense of comfort and connection, inviting the wearer to lose themselves amongst its enchanting notes.

title: Timeless Set
body:
Alexandria II - Erba Pura - Naxos - TORINO21

The Timeless Set unites Xerjoff’s four most-loved perfumes in a set of four miniature flacons.

Four enduring scents that stand out from the house’s 20-year history and continue to leave their mark on the world of perfumery, each one revealing a different side of Xerjoff's creativity.

title: Olissipo
body:
This product is available exclusively at the Xerjoff Lisbon boutique.

Xerjoff has established a tradition of creating bespoke perfumes for its monobrand boutiques, and Olissipo is the latest chapter in this series. Taking its name from what Lisbon was called in Roman times, Olissipo is a perfume that transmits the spirit and atmosphere of the Portuguese capital.

A place where old world charm meets modern intrigue. Where the cool Atlantic breeze competes with the scorching summer sun. Where architectural beauty and breathtaking views await around every Azulejo-tiled corner and at the top of every rolling hill.

title: Gibeon
body:
Soothing, yet curiosity-piquing at the same time, Gibeon is named after a meteorite with a fascinating story. Its prehistoric crash-landing in Namibia scattered iron fragments across the Kalahari desert, and it wasn’t until 1836 that Western scientists first documented it — but the local Nama people had been crafting spearheads and tools from it for centuries, perhaps even millenia.

Through its powdery, ethereal scent, Gibeon reflects the mystique of its meteorite namesake.

title: Seven
body:
This product is available exclusively at the Xerjoff Dubai boutique.

Seven is a perfume with a unique sense of opulence. Its creamy texture, paired with the softness of its scent, give it comforting and luxurious qualities that become apparent from the very first spray and linger right until the end. A scent that evolves yet whose character remains constant.

Taking inspiration from the country’s national flag, perfume Seven is housed in a black flacon. The hand-painted brushstroke finish mimics the moving sands of the desert, symbolising the constant evolution of the UAE.

title: Five
body:
This product is available exclusively at the Xerjoff Dubai boutique.

Fusing oriental, spicy and floral elements, perfume Five is a harmonious scent with an olfactory signature which is deeply rooted in the art of Arabic perfumery. A mix of delicacy and depth, light and darkness, the classic combination of rose and oud connects Five to the history and culture of the country it is dedicated to.

Taking inspiration from the country’s national flag, Five is housed in a white flacon. The hand-painted brushstroke finish mimics the moving sands of the desert, symbolising the constant evolution of the UAE.

title: Four
body:
This product is available exclusively at the Xerjoff Dubai boutique.

The olfactory pyramid of perfume Four was carefully composed to honour one particular element of the UAE’s culture: the humble date. Steeped in history and local heritage, the date and the tree that bears this delicious fruit are representative of prosperity, fertility and life itself. As a note, its tempting sweetness invigorates this perfume and contributes to its gourmand appeal.

Taking inspiration from the country’s national flag, Four is housed in a white flacon. The hand-painted brushstroke finish mimics the moving sands of the desert, symbolising the constant evolution of the UAE.

title: Three
body:
This product is available exclusively at the Xerjoff Dubai boutique.

Perfume Three is an upbeat perfume that takes advantage of nature’s bounty through its exquisite blend of fruity and floral notes. Experiencing the scent of Three is akin to walking through a desert oasis and feeling the senses nourished by the sights and smells of the lush surroundings.

Taking inspiration from the country’s national flag, Three is housed in a green flacon. The hand-painted brushstroke finish mimics the moving sands of the desert, symbolising the constant evolution of the UAE.

title: Two
body:
This product is available exclusively at the Xerjoff Dubai boutique.

The exotic-oriental scent of perfume Two is the fruit of a blend of traditional Arabic perfumery notes and exotic ingredients from far-flung lands. An intriguing perfume that also acts as a metaphor for the mix of local heritage and cultural diversity that continues to shape the UAE.

Taking inspiration from the country’s national flag, Two is housed in a green flacon which also recalls the green nuances of the scent. The hand-painted brushstroke finish mimics the moving sands of the desert, symbolising the constant evolution of the UAE.

title: One
body:
This product is available exclusively at the Xerjoff Dubai boutique.

A modern scent with many traditional traits, perfume One is part of a special collection of seven perfumes created in honour of the United Arab Emirates. This oriental fougère has genuine depth and presence, and all the requisite qualities to be worn as a statement scent.

Taking inspiration from the country’s national flag, One is housed in a red flacon, representing both the perfume’s and the UAE’s ability to balance heritage and modernity. The hand-painted brushstroke finish mimics the moving sands of the desert, symbolising the constant evolution of the UAE.

title: Nero70
body:
Suave and fascinating, Nero70 captures the same Italian essence that is found in all beautiful things that come out of il Bel Paese. It is charming, stylish and distinguished — with more than a tinge of retro appeal.

A charismatic and cultured perfume, Nero70 makes an endearing first impression and leaves a lasting mark.

title: Torino25
body:
Having been a partner of one of the sport’s most important international tournaments for years, Xerjoff has a deep conection to tennis. Tapping into that same connection, the elegant and sophisticated scent of TORINO25 captures the essence of celebration.

TORINO25 evokes the emotion of the winner’s trophy lift. The culmination of years of hard work, passion and dedication, expressed in a single gesture. This perfume is the olfactory embodiment of grace and pure elation — and the crowning achievement of a glorious legacy.

title: P.70 Limited Edition
body:
The latest releases from the Sketchbook collection explore some of the many ways in which desire manifests itself, with each offering a different perspective on the theme.

p.70 is all about possessiveness and the extremes it can drive people to. In this case, locking something up and throwing away the key so that nobody can have it. Confined by the chain and padlock, the perfume is now forbidden, but this only makes it more desirable — one always wants what they can’t have.

Each flacon is individually numbered and a true collector's item.

title: P.18  Limited Edition
body:
The latest releases from the Sketchbook collection explore some of the many ways in which desire manifests itself, with each offering a different perspective on the theme.

p.18 presents something of a paradox. Its magnetic scent invites you to come closer, but the barbed wire wrapped around its flacon warns of danger. To experience the perfume’s enchanting effects, one must accept the risk that comes with holding it.

Like love, p.18 is beauty, but also pain — its spicy oriental scent will always keep you coming back for more, even if it hurts.

Each flacon is individually numbered and a true collector's item.

title: Casamorati Discovery Set II
body:
Casamorati Discovery Set II is composed of eight 2ml perfumes, each one drawing on different aspects of Italian culture, in terms of both inspiration and ingredients. Scents that recall classics of the opera, sweet staples of southern Italian desserts, symbolic mediterranean plants and coastal towns where natural beauty and cinematic glamour meet — an entire olfactory world awaits.

title: Casamorati Discovery Set I
body:
With eight intriguing scents in travel-friendly 2ml flacons, Casamorati Discovery Set I takes the senses on a wide-ranging journey through Italian culture and Art Nouveau. From opulent celebrations and dramatic Sicilian dynasties, to aspiring Italian actresses and scented stories of new beginnings, there is an entire olfactory world to explore.

title: Louis XV 1722 Rosé
body:
Two artisanal crafts influence each other once more in the latest creation from Xerjoff’s collaborative venture with Maison de Venoge. The sophisticated de Venoge Louis XV Rosé Champagne — an exquisite rosé blend from the highly reputed champagne house — served as the muse for Louis XV 1722 Rosé.

Like the gardens of Versailles at sunrise, the scent of Louis XV 1722 Rosé is enchantingly bright and crisp. A work of true luxury, the perfume recalls the champagne blend through its sparkling composition of notes and its flacon's pink tint, encapsulating its opulence and timeless allure.

title: P.13 Limited Edition
body:
The latest releases from the Sketchbook collection explore some of the many ways in which desire manifests itself, with each offering a different perspective on the theme.

The flacon of p.13 is deliberately suggestive, designed to allow the mind to wander. Wrapped tightly in a bondage-style cord, this perfume has taboo connotations of lust and control. The seal on the cord can’t simply be opened, it must be broken in order to set the restrained subject free, creating an imbalanced dynamic: the powerless and the powerful. The tantalising crimson perfume, with its white floral scent, is left at the mercy of its owner.

Each flacon is individually numbered and a true collector's item.

title: Via Manzoni 20
body:
This product is available exclusively at the Xerjoff Milan boutique.

Via Manzoni 20 is both the address of the Xerjoff Milan boutique and the name of its exclusive perfume. A charming amber-woody scent, Via Manzoni 20 captures the mood of the city as observed at aperitivo time.

Bars, cafes and terraces populated with chic locals and stylish transplants. Chilled glasses of wine and richly-coloured spritzes sit on the tables. The constant murmur of conversation and laughter fills the air.

Rich, refined and oozing confidence, Via Manzoni 20 is right at home in the heart of the action.

body:

Modoc was a part of the Venice Skywalk Exhibition, a multisensory experience that combined soundscape, visual art, atmospheric mist and the captivating scent of this elegant perfume.

body:
A scented journey to the heart of a majestic Moroccan riad.

Home to the wealthiest citizens and courtiers, riads feature beautiful interior courtyards hidden from outside view, offering a haven of privacy, tranquility and relaxation.

Igniting the wick of the MarrakechTea scented candle opens up a special sanctuary, where stress melts away as the calming notes of mint, lavender, verbena and tea waft gently through the air.

Burning time is approximately 45 hours.

title: Coro
body:
Coro is a scent with an invigorating energy. Its vibe is that of an early riser, a go-getter who is ready to take on the world. Curtains drawn at dawn to bask in the glory of another new day, hikes to the summit and back before lunchtime.

Its energising freshness is its defining feature, a result of its purposefully curated composition.

title: Emerald Star
body:
This product is available exclusively at the Xerjoff London boutique. 

Sweet, soft and subtly endearing, Emerald Star is a perfume that keeps the skin in good company.

Created as an exclusive for Harrods, Emerald Star evolves over time, gradually revealing the full character of its composition in all its glory, one nuance at a time.

title: 40 Noeuds
body:
This product is available exclusively at the Xerjoff Monte Carlo boutique. 

40 Noeuds shares its yacht club ties with the original 40 Knots perfume, while drawing from a specifically Monègasque source of inspiration.

With 40 Noeuds, a refreshing sea breeze is felt as if standing in the Princess Grace Rose Garden, the scent of roses giving the experience a new dimension.

title: Goetheplatz
body:
Goetheplatz owes its distinctly German name to the historic square in Frankfurt.

The square is named after one of Germany’s most important literary figures and is nestled in the city’s luxury shopping district, lending it an opulence that is mirrored in the heady scent of Goetheplatz.

title: Harrods
body:
This product is available exclusively at the Casamorati London boutique. 

Casamorati Harrods was created as an exclusive for the iconic London institution that bears its name, to celebrate the opening of the first Casamorati boutique in the English capital.

A union of luxury and Italian craftsmanship, Casamorati Harrods is characterised by regal and refined notes that reflect the prestige of both establishments involved.

title: Lunosa
body:
This product is available exclusively at the Xerjoff London boutique. 

One of several Xerjoff perfumes created exclusively for Harrods, Lunosa is a showstopper in every sense of the word.

It is presented in a strikingly beautiful, hand-carved flacon, adorned with a semi-precious stone. This powerful visual statement is matched by the full-bodied character of the scent that immediately asserts itself as soon as it emerges from within.

title: Hermetic
body:
This product is available exclusively at the Xerjoff London boutique. 

Part of the alchemy-inspired Kemi collection, Hermetic possesses the mysterious charm that its name implies. Its exclusivity to Harrods only adds to the allure of this light, airy perfume.

Were it personified, Hermetic would be hard to pin down, flitting in and out as it pleases, vanishing from sight but leaving a lingering trace of its presence.

title: Sixth Floor
body:
This product is available exclusively at the Xerjoff London boutique. 

Sixth Floor was the first perfume that Xerjoff created exclusively for Harrods, its name a nod to where the Xerjoff boutique is located within the iconic London department store.

Harrods is an institution synonymous with quality, luxury and class, all of which are expressed in the aristocratic scent of Sixth Floor.

title: Begum
body:
This product is available exclusively at the Xerjoff London boutique. 

Part of the 17/17 Stone Label collection, Begum’s exclusivity to Harrods gives it an extra layer of prestige.

Straddling the worlds of old and new, Begum is a modern take on a chypre perfume. Composed of the finest natural ingredients, it radiates a relaxing, dreamlike energy and a sense of peace and tranquility.

title: Verde Accento
body:
This product is available exclusively at the Xerjoff London boutique. 

Created as an exclusive for Harrods, Verde Accento hits all the right notes, giving it the classic appeal of an all-rounder.

An exquisite composition, blended to perfection, Verde Accento conquers all with its charm, no matter the occasion or the season.

title: Torino
body:
This product is available exclusively at the Xerjoff Turin boutique. 

Turin is a city of great historical importance, serving for centuries as the cultural and political capital for the House of Savoy, before becoming the first capital of unified Italy as it is known today.

The city's elegant and regal character are reflected in this perfume, exclusively available to purchase at Xerjoff’s flagship boutique in the brand’s hometown.

1986 is strongly linked to the Candiolo Institute, one of the most important cancer facilities in Italy, which offers advanced diagnostic and therapeutic treatments, clinical trials and cutting-edge research in oncology.

1986 was created to aid the Candiolo Institute’s invaluable work, and takes its name from its year of foundation. Part of the proceeds from each sale go towards this extremely worthwhile cause.

title: Accento Overdose Pride Edition
body:
In a show of support for LGBTQ+ rights, Accento Overdose Pride Edition drapes its flacon's crystal-studded exterior in the rainbow colours of the Pride flag.

Through its use of the overdose concept — in which special molecules are used to amplify certain notes — Accento Overdose Pride Edition offers a rich and long-lasting olfactory experience.

It is a hedonistic scent that says no to minimalism and yes to maximalism. It’s about enjoying life's pleasures without worrying about moderation.

title: Alexandria II Hair Mist
body:
The natural ingredients in Alexandria II hair mist make for beautifully nourished hair. Body-enhancing properties and conditioning effects act on keratin, resulting in hair which is soft, light and full of shine and volume.

Containing the same woody-oriental composition of notes as the Alexandria II perfume, this perfumed hair mist leaves the hair both looking and smelling superb.

title: Alexandria II travel perfume
body: Bask in the luxurious notes of Alexandria II wherever your journey takes you with the Alexandria II Travel Perfume. Presented in a uniquely designed atomiser, this perfume oozes style and sophistication.

title: Alexandria II Body Powder
body: Like the parfum on which it is based, Alexandria II perfumed body powder has a scent steeped in history and rich culture. A symbol of opulence and luxury, it gets even closer to the skin while absorbing moisture.

title: Personal Discovery Set
body:
The Personal Discovery Set allows you to choose three scents that intrigue you from a carefully curated selection, designed to introduce you to the olfactory artistry of Xerjoff.

The final cost of your Personal Discovery Set will vary depending on your chosen selection of perfumes.

title: Zafar
body:
A scent born from heritage and reverence, Zafar captures the soul of desert nights, opulent majlis gatherings and whispered tales carried on the wind.

Crafted over three years with devotion and discernment, Zafar speaks of power and poise. It embodies a character both noble and enigmatic, one who moves through the world with quiet intensity and commanding presence. There's a fire beneath the surface, softened by a deep sense of grace.

title: Mamluk
body:
Sensual, intoxicating and irresistibly seductive, Mamluk by Xerjoff is a rare and precious journey through the Far East, and an invitation to indulge in a world of warmth and mystery.

Unfolding slowly on the skin, Mamluk weaves together smoky resins, soft florals and golden sweetness into a scent that feels both timeless and otherworldly.

title: Malesia
body: Malesia is a tribute to distant landscapes and time-honoured traditions. Inspired by the spirit of ancient perfumery, it reflects a world where scent is both ritual and art, crafted slowly and with intention.

title: Luxor
body: Luxor is a scent shaped by the echoes of ancient grandeur, a quiet homage to a civilization whose artistry and mystique continue to inspire. Named after the legendary city on the Nile, Luxor conjures the timeless elegance and power of pharaohs, temples and golden sands.

title: Gao
body: Gao evokes the spirit of exploration and timeless elegance. Dark, deep and undeniably powerful, this scent commands attention with its bold character and magnetic presence. Inspired by Ibn Battuta’s journey to the historic city of Gao, it captures the essence of discovery, where ancient cultures, precious resins and rare spices converge.

title: Ceylon
body:
Ceylon is an evocative perfume, inspired by the rich heritage and natural beauty of Sri Lanka. It captures a moment suspended in time, a slow afternoon where warm air carries the scent of tea leaves and distant blossoms.

From its first impression, Ceylon suggests ease and refinement. A natural warmth like sun on skin or the gentle comfort of familiar rituals. As it unfolds, Ceylon reveals a deeper complexity — softly spiced, grounded and quietly confident.

title: Al-Khatt
body:
Step into the pages of history with Al-Khatt. Crafted using traditional pure oud distillation, this perfume takes its name from the ancient Travels of Ibn Battuta manuscript, and recalls the exoticism encountered by the traveller on his voyage.

Like the tales recounted by Ibn Battuta, Al-Khatt evokes the mysterious intrigue of lands both near and far.

title: Alexandria Orientale
body: Alexandria Orientale takes the wearer to shaded palaces and sunlit deserts that whisper secrets of empires long past. The heart of antique opulence and the mystique of the East. A crossroads of culture, conquest and eternal elegance, Alexandria Orientale captures the soul of Arabic tradition and wraps it in modern luxury.

title: Alexandria II Anniversary
body:
Alexandria II Anniversary is emblematic of the complexity and triumph of Alexandria and Alexandria II from the Oud Stars collection.

A unique creation that honours the conception and significance of the two prestigious perfumes.

title: Fars
body: Rooted in the ancient traditions of Arabian perfumery, Fars is a journey through time and scent — a tribute to East meets West. A sun-drenched evening at a Middle Eastern bazaar, where spices rise in the air and the hush of incense whispers through the dusk. From this world of opulence and ritual, Fars is born.

title: Alexandria III
body:
Xerjoff Alexandria III is not merely a perfume — it is a story told in scent, a voyage whispered through time and tradition. This creation began with a shared vision between Sergio Momo and Kostas, Xerjoff's beloved UK Brand Ambassador whose deep reverence for rare ingredients and storytelling through scent helped shape its soul.

Drawing upon his personal love for oud and the artistry behind traditional Middle Eastern perfumery, Kostas worked closely with Sergio to craft a scent that would feel like a secret passed down through generations.

title: Alexandria II
body:
Inspired by the ancient Arabian art of perfumery, Alexandria II captures the essence of the city that has long been a crossroads of cultures, history and trade.

Just like Alexandria — a vibrant mosaic of tradition and innovation — this fragrance blends timeless elegance with a fresh, lively spirit.

title: Kampuchea Noir
body:
The name and colour of this attar allude to its potency. Kampuchea Noir is the purest oil of the XJ Oud collection, with a single-ingredient composition.

A truly rich and powerful scent, Kampuchea Noir is an ode to the traditions of Arabian perfumery, and an example of the olfactory beauty that nature provides.

title: Java Blossom
body:
Java Blossom is a unique composition. Smooth, complex and elegant, it evokes a serene walk through a tropical forest.

The warm earthiness of the soil. The green aroma of the trees and the sweetness of the fruit growing from them. The gentle softness of the flowers in bloom all around.

title: Tempest
body:
Tempest was inspired by the Shakespearean play of the same name, in which the protagonist uses alchemical magic to conjure up a great storm.

In Tempest, the alchemy between the notes takes the senses on a voyage and offers a unique olfactory experience to all those who encounter it.

title: TuberHype
body:
Depart on an unforgettable voyage across the vast flower fields of India, where tuberose grows in abundance.

Like the tuberose in those fields, whose presence is felt in the aroma that lingers long after the sun goes down, the sweet narrative of Xerjoff’s TuberHype candle remains long in the memories of those who experience it.

Burning time is approximately 45 hours.

title: MidGardenia
body:
Take a stroll through a flower garden in northern Italy, where nature speaks to the soul through the scent of some of its most beautiful creations.

MidGardenia offers a serene interlude from the hustle and bustle of daily life, one to be embraced each time it is lit.

Burning time is approximately 45 hours.

title: SilkyGreen
body:
The sophistication of SilkyGreen sets the tone for a garden party to remember.

Fresh and earthy notes of green grass linger among the spicier scents that drift from the kitchen, while glasses clink and laughter fills the air. Sweetly scented flowers intertwine with the guests’ perfume, as the senses settle in a place of contentment and cosiness.

Burning time is approximately 45 hours.

title: VintaClub
body:
Step into the club.

The VintaClub scented candle from Xerjoff evokes the atmosphere of the private members’ clubs frequented by the elites of nineteenth century Britain.

Reminiscent of worn leather and wooden furniture set among the clubs’ high ceilings and grandiose décor, VintaClub warms the senses and recalls a bygone era.

Burning time is approximately 45 hours.

title: TobaTonka
body:
TobaTonka was conceived with a specific scene in mind: a cosy living room warmed by a crackling fire, inviting you to curl up in the worn leather armchair and leaf through the faded pages of the well-worn books that line the shelves.

The sweet, smoky scent of the TobaTonka scented candle hangs in the air, enticing you further into this relaxing atmosphere.

Burning time is approximately 45 hours.

title: DarkViolette
body:
Feel the stress dissipate as the scent and glow of DarkViolette put the finishing touches on a soothing atmosphere.

Xerjoff’s DarkViolette candle from the Limoges collection is the perfect accompaniment to warm lighting and soft, relaxing music on dark evenings. Sit back and unwind as it diffuses a constant gentle aroma that makes life feel more peaceful.

Burning time is approximately 45 hours.

title: Blue Scented Candles
body:
Embark on a trip around the globe and embrace the many wonders of the world with a curated selection of three scented candles from the Xerjoff Scentimento candle collection.

This set contains three 60g scented candles, setting off on an opulent olfactory journey marked by the intriguing nuances of TrueBlue, BellaNotte and LunaLovers.

title: Black Scented Candles
body:
Embark on a trip around the globe and embrace the many wonders of the world with a curated selection of three scented candles from the Xerjoff Scentimento candle collection.

This set contains three 60g scented candles, setting off on an opulent olfactory journey marked by the intriguing nuances of TobacDorè, NoirDeNoir, BlancDeNoir.

title: NoirDeNoir
body:
NoirDeNoir evokes the vibrant lifestyle of South Florida and its stunning coastline, from the serenity of Sanibel Island to the iconic vibe and neon lights that line Ocean Drive.

The vessel of each candle in the Scentimento collection bears a two-tone swirling pattern inspired by the movement of the ocean, a reminder of earth’s infinite beauty.

Burning time is approximately 100-110 hours for 750g candles and 35 hours for 170g candles.

title: TrueBlue
body:
Set a match to the wick of TrueBlue and board a sailboat in the port of Siracusa, Sicily. Traverse the Mediterranean Sea as the candle’s aroma guides you to the crystal clear waters of Crete.

The vessel of each candle in the Scentimento collection bears a two-tone swirling pattern inspired by the movement of the ocean, a reminder of earth’s infinite beauty.

Burning time is approximately 100-110 hours for 750g candles and 35 hours for 170g candles.

title: TabacDoré
body:
TabacDorè transports you to the tropical coast of Honduras, where blue skies and clear waters are the backdrop to the lush and colourful plant life.

The vessel of each candle in the Scentimento collection bears a two-tone swirling pattern inspired by the movement of the ocean, a reminder of earth’s infinite beauty.

Burning time is approximately 100-110 hours for 750g candles and 35 hours for 170g candles.

title: LunaLovers
body:
Lively and spirited, LunaLovers is reminiscent of the true beauty that lies in the Caribbean islands. White sands, turquoise waters, captivating sunsets and a slower pace of life.

The vessel of each candle in the Scentimento collection bears a two-tone swirling pattern inspired by the movement of the ocean, a reminder of earth’s infinite beauty.

Burning time is approximately 100-110 hours for 750g candles and 35 hours for 170g candles.

title: BlancDeNoir
body:
A vibrant and enticing scent, BlancDeNoir is reminiscent of the excitement that comes with an adventure in Latin America. Its warm and inviting character fills the room, creating a welcoming, festive atmosphere.

The vessel of each candle in the Scentimento collection bears a two-tone swirling pattern inspired by the movement of the ocean, a reminder of earth’s infinite beauty.

Burning time is approximately 100-110 hours for 750g candles and 35 hours for 170g candles.

title: BellaNotte
body:
BellaNotte recalls the beautiful botanical gardens in South East Asia, covered by the blanket of a celestial night sky. On balmy summer nights there, the air is tinged with the scent of the flowers, fruits and trees below.

The vessel of each candle in the Scentimento collection bears a two-tone swirling pattern inspired by the movement of the ocean, a reminder of earth’s infinite beauty.

Burning time is approximately 100-110 hours for 750g candles and 35 hours for 170g candles.

title: Alexandria II
body:
Inspired by the great Egyptian city of the same name, Alexandria II is a scent that has taken many different forms, building a considerable legacy.

With its rich and luxurious composition, Alexandria II was conceived as an ode to Arabian perfumery. Originally released as a parfum, it is even more potent as an attar.

title: Oud Luban
body:
Oud Luban is a traditional attar blend that has the power to instantly transport you to the medinas of Marrakech and Cairo, or the Grand Bazaar of Istanbul.

A highly evocative scent that captures the essence of Arabian perfumery through its composition of natural, characterful ingredients and their precise, studied blending.

title: Black Sukar
body:
Applying Black Sukar attar to the skin is a very personal ritual, and the beginning of a truly luxurious experience.

A couple of carefully placed drops are enough for Black Sukar to exude its rich, intense scent to great effect, creating an intimate aura of opulence that surrounds the wearer.

title: King Masarat
body:
King Masarat is a potent attar made from some of the most prized ingredients in perfumery, among them three varieties of oud, a cornerstone of Middle Eastern perfumery for millennia.

Rich, smooth and intimate in nature, this powerful perfume oil envelops the wearer in their own luxuriously scented cloud for hours on end.

title: Warda Al Oud
body:
In both its name and its composition, Warda Al Oud pays homage to the excellence and traditions of Middle Eastern perfumery.

Its name is Arabic for rose oud, referring to its two primary ingredients, historically favoured as a pairing for the richness, depth and soft floral tones that bring out the best in each other.

title: Save Me
body:
Save Me was launched as part of the Spray to Help initiative in collaboration with the Save Me Trust, a welfare organisation founded by Dr. Brian May and Anne Brummer to protect wild animals.

The association works in partnership with NGOs, the government and the business sector with the aim of safeguarding wildlife and bringing about sustainable change at all levels.

Part of the proceeds from the sale of each Save Me perfume are donated to the trust.

title: Coexistence
body:
CoExistence is a perfume created in conjunction with the Great Elephant Migration. The project sees a captivating herd of hand-made elephant statues migrate across America to encourage peaceful coexistence among all living beings.

Part of the proceeds from this Spray to Help perfume will go to the cause. From elephants, leopards, rhinos and tigers, all the funds raised through the Great Elephant Migration are directed to projects that help the human race share space.

title: Kobe
body:
On a September evening In 1999, many onlookers in Kobe City, Japan, witnessed a meteorite blazing a trail overhead before a crash-landing brought it to a stop.

Like the fireball seen in the sky before the impact, the intense power of Kobe by Xerjoff captivates all who experience it.

title: Lua
body:
Fresh, fruity and irresistible, Lua takes its name from a meteorite that fell to earth in 1926, landing in the Rajasthan region of India.

Light and airy, Lua is an expertly blended perfume with a hint of gourmand appeal. It leaves the senses wanting more and puts all those in its vicinity under its spell.

title: Allende
body:
In the early hours of February 8, 1969, residents of Pueblito di Allende in Mexico witnessed a fireball in the sky, followed by a sonic boom and earth-shaking vibrations as a meteorite crashed to earth.

Taking its name from this spectacular incident, Allende is a perfume that lives long in the memory of those who encounter it.

title: Aridal
body:
Scouring the desert region of Boujdour in southern Morocco, researchers found exactly what they were looking for.

Aridal takes its name from the series of meteorites that they happened upon, scattered across the barren Sahara landscape. Like its celestial namesakes, this perfume delights those who discover it.

title: Apollonia
body:
Glinting stars catch the eye from light-years away as the moon’s glow lays a soft blanket over the landscape.

With an otherworldly quality about it, Apollonia transmits the sense of wonder that is felt when staring up at the clear night sky. In this dreamlike state, you feel a connection to the object of your gaze.

title: Cruz Del Sur II
body:
Cruz del Sur II is inspired by Xerjoff founder Sergio Momo’s travels to the depths of the Amazon rainforest, a true adventure that saw him come face to face with nature at its most awe-inspiring.

Cruz del Sur II takes the senses on a breathtaking journey through the jungles of South America, where wildlife has thrived for millennia and the air is heavy with a mystical charm.

title: Cruz Del Sur I
body:
Cruz del Sur I is the essence of nature in its purest form, from the Amazon river and the fruits of the rainforest, to the indigenous people and their way of life.

This deep, velvety perfume is inspired by the Meeting of the Waters, where the Rio Negro and the Amazon create a powerful visual contrast, eternally flowing side by side without ever mixing.

title: Torino21 Deodorant Spray
body:
TORINO21 deodorant spray offers a new way to experience the revitalising freshness of the eponymous perfume from the Join the Club collection. Drying instantly upon application thanks to its micronised delivery, the no gas properties of TORINO21 deodorant spray allow the scent to linger while also lending a softness to the skin.

TORINO21 deodorant spray gives you the same scented experience of TORINO21 eau de parfum, with the added functionality of keeping you fresh all day long.

title: Blue Hope
body:
Complex and intriguing, Blue Hope offers an olfactory experience like no other.

The celestial inspiration of the Shooting Stars collection is reflected in the air of mystery that Blue Hope possesses. This scent takes the nose on an unexpected journey, revealing diverse facets and tones as it progresses.

title: Red Hoba
body:
Taking its name from the Hoba meteorite that crashed in Namibia over 80,000 years ago, Red Hoba shimmers like a mirage in the desert. With every glimpse, its form is altered — largely the same, but somehow changed.

Red Hoba stirs the senses, challenging them to deepen their understanding of its protean character.

title: Oesel
body:
On a clear day in May 1855, with an easterly wind blowing, several locals witnessed a meteor shower on the Estonian island of Oesel. Their firsthand accounts of the phenomenon ensured the story of the Oesel meteorite would live on forever.

With its celestial intrigue and elegant, refined scent, Oesel is a perfume that is sure to be talked about by those lucky enough to experience it, even long after the event.

title: Nio
body:
In the late 19th century, the Nio meteorite was seen falling to earth in Yoshiki, Japan, leaving fragments scattered across a bamboo grove. Part of the Shooting Stars collection, Nio takes its name from this meteorite.

The green and woody elements of Nio's character recall the site of its discovery, while Japan's storied history of cultivating citrus fruits comes through in the perfume's zesty freshness.

title: Uden Overdose
body:
A single encounter with a captivating scent can turn into a memory that lasts a lifetime, and Uden Overdose is one of those perfumes.

Ten years after introducing Uden, one of the protagonists of the Shooting Stars collection, Xerjoff created Uden Overdose, a scent that builds on the character of the original through its use of the overdose concept — which sees special molecules used to amplify certain notes.

title: Uden
body:
Taking its name from the meteorite that landed in the Netherlands in 1840, Uden is reminiscent of a walk along the breezy coastline of the North Sea.

Waves lapping on the shore, a cool wind carrying the salty, mineral smell of the sea, while the skin feels the warm caress of the sun.

title: Purple Accento
body:
Purple Accento is a scent that intrigues the nose. It elicits a flash of partial recognition at first contact, followed by a strong desire to get close and understand its full splendour.

While sharing the elegance associated with the colour purple, it has an upbeat, fascinating character at the same time. This blend of refinement and exuberance makes for a uniquely charismatic perfume.

title: Purple Accento Crystal Edition
body:
Purple Accento is a scent that intrigues the nose. It elicits a flash of partial recognition at first contact, followed by a strong desire to get close and understand its full splendour.

The extravagant colour and crystal studs on the outside of its flacon give off the same vibe as the precious perfume within it — fascinating, upbeat and charismatic.

title: P.33 Blank Page Edition
body:
P.33 Blank Page Edition offers the same delectable scent as p.33, presented in a more subdued fashion.

While the original p.33 comes in a flacon hand-crafted in Tuscany, p.33 Blank Page Edition has an understated exterior that corresponds to the timeless perfume within.

title: P.33
body:
For many years, the engraved flacon of p.33 existed only on the pages of Sergio Momo’s sketchbook, before fulfilling its destiny of becoming a real-life artisanal creation, filled with an alluring parfum that’s perfect for any season.

Exquisite and exclusive, each flacon has been hand-crafted in Tuscany using only the finest quality materials.

title: White On White
body:
Before even lifting the cap, the suggestivity of the name White on White — and its appropriately coloured flacon — creates the expectation of a soft, comforting perfume with a delicate caress.

Exclusive to the Xerjoff online and physical boutiques, White on White lives up to that expectation from the very first spray. Each time the senses pick up a waft of the scent, you fall deeper under its spell.

title: Via Cavour 1
body:
Via Cavour is a historic street in Turin, Italy, and Via Cavour 1 was the location of the first Xerjoff flagship store in the house's hometown. 

As well as sharing a name, both the perfume and the street have an unmistakable air of elegance in common. Via Cavour 1 is a luxurious and sensual scent with a seductive appeal that is impossible to ignore.

title: Starlight
body:
Rather than shine or sparkle as its name may suggest, Starlight illuminates in its own uniquely beautiful way. It is a scent that emanates warmth, comfort and an air of nobility.

A masterpiece of the spicy perfume genre, Starlight is peppered with piquant notes that intrigue the senses and leave them wanting more.

title: La Capitale
body:
La Capitale unites many traits and qualities that are highly sought-after in perfumery. Distinguished, seductive and versatile, its allure depends neither on the situation, nor the season. 

The varied yet harmonious composition of La Capitale allows each note to play its part, amounting to a scent that has a lot to offer to even the most discerning noses.

title: Newcleus
body:
Newcleus pushes the boundaries of traditional perfumery. Rather than the typical liquid format, Newcleus sees the perfume encapsulated within alginate spheres. These delicate capsules release their scent only upon contact with the skin, gently bursting to deliver an enchanting perfume experience.

Newcleus offers a soothing sensation that nourishes both skin and senses, no matter how sensitive.

title: Shunkoin
body:
Be still and serene with Shunkoin, a perfume that draws from the world of spiritual wellbeing, an ode to the peace and tranquility that meditation brings.

As the clouds part after a cleansing rainfall on a summer’s day, Shunkoin is the first ray of sunshine that touches your skin, warming your heart and reminding you that all is well.

title: K' Bridge Club
body:
K'Bridge Club takes its name and inspiration from Knightsbridge in London, one of the most exclusive and high-end retail districts in the world.

Shoppers enter Knightsbridge with a mentality of “only the finest will do”, and with its exquisite medley of sweet and floral facets, K’Bridge Club echoes that sentiment. A refined perfume for the most discerning of noses.

title: More Than Words
body:
More Than Words imagines a secret society of writers and poets that use the written word to express their boundless creativity, inviting their readers to lose themselves in the story.

Like the work of those writers, More Than Words transports you to another time and place, evoking powerful sensations through the wonders of scent.

title: Ivory Route
body:
Ivory Route is instilled with the passion and yearning for discovery that all travellers carry in their heart.

A perfume that captures the essence of true adventure. The kind where the destination is unknown on departure and the favoured path is the one less travelled. Ivory Route is for those who know that variety is the spice of life.

title: Fatal Charme
body:
Fashion reigns supreme with Fatal Charme, a powdery, floral scent that pays tribute to the luxurious world of haute couture.

The refinement of the designs, the quality of the materials and the exclusivity of the rarest, almost unattainable pieces — Fatal Charme encapsulates all that is associated with the high fashion scene.

title: Don
body:
Dark, intense and enthralling, Don borrows from 20th century Hollywood’s glamorous world of gangster epics.

Smoky bars with low lighting where cash and alcohol flow freely, narrow back alleys that serve as late-night escape routes — Don recalls the mystique of these settings and the brooding charisma of the sharply-dressed protagonists.

title: Comandante!
body:
Comandante! is inspired by the classic smoking clubs of old, where gentlemen would congregate to relax, socialise and indulge in the pleasure of a quality cigar or two.

Comandante! seeks to replicate the ambiance of these settings rather than the scent: the dimly-lit rooms, worn leather armchairs and the steady flow of engaging conversation in good company.

title: Ascot Moon
body:
Ascot Moon pays homage to the horse racing and polo circuits, saluting the grandeur and spectacle of these distinguished equine games. 

Events within these circles are a meeting place for those in high society, a chance to showcase their elegance and class amongst the heady scents of leather riding boots, rustic tweeds and fresh green grass.

400 is inspired by the experience of shopping at 400 Oxford Street in London, home to one of the most celebrated retail stores in the world.

The luxurious roots of 400 inform its character. It is a soft, sweet, expertly-blended scent that entices the nose and leaves it desiring more.

title: 40 Knots Deodorant Spray
body:
40 Knots deodorant spray offers a new way to experience the breezy freshness of the eponymous perfume from the Join the Club collection. Drying instantly on the skin thanks to its micronised delivery, the no gas properties of 40 Knots deodorant spray allow the scent to linger while also lending a softness to the skin.

The pump spray design of the deodorant is considerate of even the most sensitive skin, delivering a zesty surge of refreshing energy in the form of a fine mist.

title: 40 Knots
body:
Taking its inspiration from the exclusive yacht club lifestyle, 40 Knots brings you aboard a sailboat gliding across the mesmerising Mediterranean sea.

The salty spray in the air, the beauty of the sun’s rays glistening on the turquoise waters and the taste of freedom that comes from the open water — all captured in this highly evocative perfume.

title: Birdie
body:
Birdie is Xerjoff's tribute to the exclusive golf clubs whose much-prized memberships come with significant prestige.

The sensations of playing a round on an impeccably-kept course are captured in Birdie: the calming effect of the tranquil, green surroundings, the cool breeze against your skin, and the earthen feel of the soil underfoot as you walk down the fairway.

title: Louis XV 1722
body:
A fusion of tradition, passion and artisanal expertise, Louis XV 1722 is the result of Xerjoff’s artistic exploration with Maison de Venoge, one of France’s most prestigious Champagne houses.

Emblematic of truly luxurious celebration, Louis XV 1722 is a fresh and original composition that lifts the spirits and stirs the senses.

title: Tony Iommi Monkey Special
body:
Tony Iommi Monkey Special is the first chapter of Xerjoff’s multisensory collaboration with legendary Black Sabbath Guitarist, Tony Iommi.

In Tony Iommi Monkey Special, Iommi’s musical talent and artistic sensibilities are conveyed through an alternative prism, expressing what rock 'n' roll in the late '60s was for him through the medium of scent.

title: Groove Xcape
body:
Born from Xerjoff’s collaboration with Max Casacci, musical pioneer and co-founder of Subsonica, Groove Xcape is an opera of sensory fusion, where sound and scent are each other’s muse.

The perfume draws inspiration from Casacci’s innovative Groove X-capes track, which he created  using only the delicate swirling, spritzing and clinking sounds of Xerjoff perfumes. In this collaboration, two art forms combine to create something new.

title: Amabile
body:
Amabile is an energetic, transportive perfume that bursts into life the second it leaves its flacon. Picture a forest of lush, exotic greenery purifying the air, resplendent in its chlorophyll glow under the morning sun.

Amabile instantly takes you there, and the adventure is just beginning.

1888 by Casamorati is a timeless, woody-amber scent that tells a story of Italian craftsmanship and the pursuit of excellence.

With its comforting warmth, mild spiciness and subtle animalic accent, 1888 pays homage to Tuscany’s historic tradition of leather tanning.

A slow, deliberate process that — much like the art of perfumery itself — uses the finest natural ingredients to create something that’s truly worth cherishing.

title: Duran Duran NeoRio — Orange Flacon
body:
Bold and captivating, NeoRio mirrors Duran Duran’s ever-evolving spirit and boundary-breaking energy — a quality embedded in Xerjoff’s DNA.

Past, present and future collide in a perfume as magnetic and unpredictable as the band itself, a celebration of boundless energy, freedom and the thrill of life's most exhilarating moments.
