title: Sample Kit
body:
The Sample Kit offers a gateway to the vast and varied portfolio of Xerjoff perfumes. Choose up to four scents that pique your curiosity and receive a 2ml sample of each, allowing you to acquaint yourself with their character and nuances — and to discover your new favourites.

For every purchase over €100 (excluding Sample Kits), enjoy a complimentary Sample Kit as Xerjoff's gift to you.

With the purchase of one or two Sample Kits, you’ll receive a promotional code equivalent to the value of one kit, redeemable on your next purchase over €200 within two months.

Please note, a maximum of two Sample Kits may be ordered per transaction.

title: Zefiro
body:
A rich, layered scent, Zefiro takes its name from the eponymous westerly wind that blows across the Mediterranean sea during the summer months. Wearing Zefiro is like taking an evening stroll through the ancient cobbled streets of Rome and feeling the enormity of the city’s history in the air, made tangible by the caress of that gentle breeze.

So many olfactory traits that have characterised Rome for centuries — like the smell of sweet incense wafting out of open church doorways and the zest of the orange trees that line the city’s streets — are recreated in the intoxicating oriental scent of Zefiro.

title: Decas
body: Part of the 1861 collection celebrating the history and identity of Italy, Decas takes its name from the Latin word for the number ten. The most recent addition to the collection, Decas arrived a decade after the launch of the first 1861 perfume. A sophisticated scent, its endearing character is defined by a soft sweetness.

title: Layla
body:
Drift into the mystical skies with Layla, a romantic interpretation of the celestial world.

Taking its name from the Arabic word for night, this magical perfume has a calm and serene character, with seductive notes that glitter like distant stars.

title: Irisss
body:
With its slightly dusty, powdery scent, Irisss paints a picture of an impeccably furnished palace, setting a scene of comfort and luxury, and offering a hint of aristocratic glamour.

Irisss owes its distinctive cold and powdery charm to the presence of iris butter. This rare ingredient exudes elegance, as if it were a relic encased in crystal for all to admire.

title: Richwood
body:
While travelling through Southeast Asia, Xerjoff founder Sergio Momo came across an ancient statue of the Buddha, carved out of sandalwood. Sandalwood is sacred in many Asian cultures, symbolising purity and divinity, and said to repel negative forces.

Struck by the sweetness of the sandalwood, the great cultural significance wrapped up in the statue and the beauty of his encounter with it, he set himself the challenge of capturing the essence of this moment in a scent, and Richwood was born.

title: Kemi
body:
Taking its name from the ancient word for Egypt, Kemi is inspired by the Land of the Pharaohs.

Considered the birthplace of alchemy, the works produced in Greco-Roman Egypt influenced philosophy for centuries to follow, and their importance to the development of perfumery is undeniable.

title: Fiore D’ulivo
body:
A modern-day incarnation of a perfume initially released by Casamorati in the late 1800s, the composition of Fiore d’Ulivo remains largely unchanged from the original recipe.

Just as its predecessor did, Fiore d’Ulivo takes its inspiration from a staple of the Mediterranean region, the olive tree. Cherished for its practical and symbolic value, and representative of humankind’s connection to nature.

title: Discovery Set III
body:
Naxos - Alexandria II - Golden Dallah

Discovery Set III takes you on a sensory adventure across continents and cultures. Naxos conjures up idyllic images of Sicilian beauty with its citrus freshness. Alexandria II evokes the charm and mystery of the ancient city that bears its name through the combo of oud and rose. Golden Dallah entices with the warmth and spice of the coffee enjoyed in the Middle East.

Three miniature flacons, three olfactory journeys.

Click here for ingredients: Naxos, Alexandria II, Golden Dallah

title: Pikovaya Dama
body:
An homage to Aleksandr Puskin’s seminal 1834 novel, The Queen of Spades, Pikovaya Dama seeks to recreate the drama and intrigue of the story in scent form, taking the original Russian version of its name.

A semi-precious stone, tiger’s eye, is embedded in the flacon. Its intricate, silky-textured streaks possess a timeless beauty, much like the perfume itself.

title: Elle
body:
Elle holds a special place both in the 17/17 Stone Label collection and the story of Xerjoff, as the very first creation of each. Its conception as a distinctly feminine scent sets it apart from the majority of Xerjoff perfumes, which have a unisex appeal.

Embedded in the exterior of its flacon is a cream-coloured jasper stone, believed to possess a soothing, nurturing energy, giving it an elegant aesthetic to match the scent held within.

title: Aurum
body:
Aurum’s name derives from the Latin word for gold. The ultimate symbol of luxury, wealth and victory to most, but in alchemy, gold held a greater significance.

To alchemists, it stood for purity, perfection and spiritual enlightenment, and for these reasons they sought to transform other metals into gold.

In Aurum, raw ingredients have been distilled and transformed into pure magic.

title: La Tosca
body:
Inspired by one of the finest works from master composer Giacomo Puccini, La Tosca is immediately evocative of the splendour of Italian opera.

A floral aromatic scent, it seeks to recreate a sense of the era from which it takes its name, when detail was cherished for its inherent beauty.

title: Lira
body:
Lira is a perfume whose every aspect enchants, from its deliciously tempting scent to its poetic origin story. Its name derives from the Italian word for lyre, the ancient musical instrument which holds great significance in mythology.

Lira is based on a perfume originally released by Casamorati in the late 1800s that was created to help a beautiful, aspiring actress realise her dreams. It was intended to make a lasting impression on all those who encountered it, just like the sweet music of the lyre.

title: Elle Anniversary
body:
Created as a tribute to the very first Xerjoff perfume, Elle Anniversary maintains the floral charm and sophistication of the original Elle fragrance, while caressing the wearer with a sweet, youthful touch.

Its flacon is bestowed with a mother of pearl stone, which is said to have a divine feminine energy that nourishes the soul. A fitting adornment for a fragrance with so many deliciously gourmand notes.

title: Torino24
body:
TORINO24 is a scent that evokes the spirit and atmosphere of a friendly indoor tennis match, 
and the environment and materials that play their part in creating the ambience.

The essential components of the match are captured in the blend, from the rubbery core of the tennis ball that bounces off the indoor court to the wooden tennis racket in hand.

title: Fiero
body:
Fiero is the olfactory embodiment of la sprezzatura italiana, the art of seeming effortlessly stylish and well-presented. It has a dignified air, nestled between elegance and nonchalance.

From its green glass flacon to its classically structured notes, every aspect of Fiero paints a picture of class, refinement and good taste.

title: Holysm
body:
Taking its name and inspiration from one of the core concepts of alchemical philosophy, Holysm encapsulates the idea of interconnection and the whole being greater than the sum of its parts.

Holysm is a selection of diverse, individual notes, distilled and blended so that each can interact with and influence the others. The result is a strikingly beautiful scent.

title: Discovery Set I
body:
Cruz Del Sur II - Erba Pura - Uden Overdose

Discovery Set I is a sweet, sparkling odyssey of fruity perfumes. The exotic top notes of Cruz del Sur II, the irresistible juiciness of Erba Pura and the citrus allure of Uden Overdose go hand in hand in this set of three 15ml flacons.

Three delectable, complementary scents, three reasons to fall in love with artistic perfumery.

Click here for ingredients: Cruz Del Sur II, Erba Pura, Uden Overdose

title: Amber Star & Star Musk
body:
Discover the power of harmonious scent with the Xerjoff Mixing Experience. Amber Star and Star Musk each have their own individual qualities and were conceived with a dual purpose — to be worn separately and also layered together.

When the complementary compositions of these two scents meet on the skin, sparks fly. They can be dosed as the wearer pleases, allowing for endless blends and the creation of a personalised, signature scent.

title: Gran Ballo
body:
A joyful expression of the innocence of young love, Gran Ballo leads the senses on a waltz around the grand palace.

It is inspired by the grandeur of 19th century aristocratic parties attended by young ladies hoping to find their own Prince Charming. An opulent night between youth and womanhood.

title: Torino22
body:
The second perfume created for the Nitto ATP Finals in Turin. TORINO21 was inspired by the wait, but TORINO22 is all about the action.

The powerful serves. The agility, split-second instinct and decisiveness displayed on the court. The roar unleashed by the crowd as a player seals match point. The exhilaration.

title: Renaissance
body:
Renaissance, from the 1861 collection, draws its inspiration — and name — from one of the most important artistic and cultural periods in history. A movement driven by the desire to revive and improve upon the great ideas and achievements of the past.

Renaissance is a celebration of Italian artistry and an homage to the supremely gifted artists who changed the course of history through their talent, vision and works of great beauty.

title: Luna
body:
The moon has fascinated man since the dawn of humanity and was of great symbolic importance in alchemy.

The changing phases of the moon represent transformation, purification and rebirth, three concepts central to both alchemical processes and the distillation techniques used in perfumery.

In the creation of Luna, its ingredients have been purified, transformed and reborn as a scent, continuing the alchemists’ legacy.

title: Regio
body:
Regio takes the nose on a voyage to the bergamot tree-lined shores of Calabria, where the sea breeze carries with it a revitalizing freshness, a reprieve from the hot sun.

The Calabrian coast is just one stop on this journey of olfactory enlightenment. There are more layers to Regio than one might expect, as the perfume reveals its delightful nuances as time weaves its thread.

title: Discovery Set II
body:
Muse - Apollonia - Accento Overdose

Discovery Set II explores the power of perfumery through three scents that have intriguing effects on the senses. Muse’s fruity-floral character and the energy it inspires. The atmospheric beauty of Apollonia and the sense of distance it evokes. Accento Overdose and its specially amplified notes.

Three miniature flacons, three uniquely impactful sensations.

Click here for ingredients: Muse, Apollonia, Accento Overdose

title: Torino23
body:
TORINO23 is a scent as graceful as the game of tennis itself. Timeless and traditional, TORINO23 evokes the same class and sophistication that lie at the heart of the sport at the highest level.

Think meticulously-kept lawn clubs with fresh, clean lines, and agile, fluid movements of players in perfectly white polo shirts who make it all look so effortless.

title: Torino24
body:
TORINO24 is a scent that evokes the spirit and atmosphere of a friendly indoor tennis match,
and the environment and materials that play their part in creating the ambience.

The essential components of the match are captured in the blend, from the rubbery core of the tennis ball that bounces off the indoor court to the wooden tennis racket in hand.

title: Torino22
body:
TORINO22 is another perfume centred on the world of professional tennis. TORINO21 was inspired by the wait, but TORINO22 is all about the action.

The powerful serves. The agility, split-second instinct and decisiveness displayed on the court. The roar unleashed by the crowd as a player seals match point.

title: Torino21
body:
Inspired by the highly competitive world of professional tennis, TORINO21 captures the adrenaline-filled pre-match atmosphere of a match at the highest level.

The electricity in the air, the concentration of the two adversaries preparing to face off on the court and the baited breath of the waiting crowd. The sense of expectation ahead of watching — and experiencing — something spectacular.

TORINO21 is a fresh, revitalising scent that combines the artistry of perfumery with the excitement of professional sport, preserving the emotion that each evokes.

title: Soprano
body:
Soprano gives off a calm and idyllic energy. The kind that is felt on an early morning visit to a country market, when the sun has not long risen, the vendors are peacefully setting out their fruit and flowers and the first customers are yet to arrive.

Many perfumes composed with care and precision are defined by their elegant and aristocratic appeal, but instead, Soprano exudes a delightfully nonchalant charm.

title: Duran Duran Black Moonlight
body:
Sensuous, daring and irresistibly evocative, Black Moonlight accompanies the wearer on a journey deep into the heart of the night, where untold secrets whisper and the edge of darkness ignites intrigue.

Inspired by the interplay of light and shadow that defines Duran Duran’s music, this exquisite scent embodies the allure of mystery and the quiet power of self-expression.

title: Aqua Regia
body:
Aqua Regia evokes the greatest pursuit in the alchemic world; the quest to transform base metals into precious ones.

Blending a carefully composed selection of notes, it conjures up the resplendance of gold and the resilience of platinum, casting a mesmerising spell on everything it touches.

title: Homme Anniversary
body:
Homme Anniversary was created in honour of the 17 year anniversary of the first-ever Xerjoff perfume collection, the 17/17 Stone Label collection.

Homme Anniversary pays tribute to the story of Xerjoff while encapsulating the creativity that characterises the brand.

A grey mother of pearl stone is framed by intricately crafted gold-leaf details that adorn the flacon.

title: Discovery Set IV
body:
La Capitale - Pikovaya Dama - More Than Words

Discovery Set IV blends heritage, passion and class. The cultured scent of La Capitale offers sweetness, spice and a warm heart. Pikovaya Dama embodies refinement and sophistication through its powdery, floral charm. More Than Words transports you to another time and place, like the devoted writers that inspired it.

Three miniature flacons, three effortlessly elegant scents.

Click here for ingredients: La Capitale, Pikovaya Dama, More Than Words

title: Erba Gold
body:
With its enticing tropical sweetness, Erba Gold gives off a playful, vibrant and magnetic energy.

It evokes a sense of youthful vitality, like an adventure in an unfamiliar and intriguing destination, where you’re surrounded by new faces and places, with the inescapable feeling that good times abound.

title: Damarose
body:
If one closes their eyes and inhales deeply as a spray of Damarose settles on the skin, the sensory experience that follows is like strolling through a rose garden at dawn, as fresh droplets of dew glisten on the petals.

The elegance and grace of Damarose is reflected in the design of its clear glass flacon, which is adorned with a semi-precious and subtly beautiful red tiger eye stone.

title: Empiryan
body:
Empiryan’s name comes from ancient cosmology, where it meant “the highest heaven”, home of the divine intellect beyond the physical realm.

Through ingredients sourced straight from the earth, precise distillation techniques and a mesmering scent that evokes strong emotions and sensations, Empiryan has an otherworldly effect on the senses.

title: Accento
body:
The vibe of Accento is effortlessly classy. Like the pastel-coloured facades of Nice’s old town, warmed by the golden sunshine. Palm trees lining the promenade, clear blue sky and sparkling turquoise waters. A well-dressed stranger walks by, leaving the scent of Accento in their wake.

Just as the right soundtrack can make a film into a masterpiece, the right perfume can turn a beautiful moment into an unforgettable, multisensory experience.

title: Erba Pura Deodorant Spray
body:
Erba Pura deodorant spray offers a new way to experience the citrusy freshness of the eponymous perfume from the Vibe collection. Drying instantly on the skin thanks to its micronised delivery, the no gas properties of Erba Pura deodorant spray allow the scent to linger while also lending a softness to the skin.

The pump spray design of the deodorant is considerate of even the most sensitive skin, delivering a zesty surge of refreshing energy in the form of a fine mist.

title: Levar Del Sole
body:
Levar del Sole is symbolic in every aspect, from its name and flacon design to the selectivity of its ingredients — its top note of Kannauj rose in particular.

Kannauj rose petals are harvested by hand just after sunrise, still damp with dew and with their scent at its most intense.

The ritualistic nature of this act is a real life demonstration of the beauty that awaits at every new dawn.

title: Mefisto Gentiluomo
body:
Originally created in 1888 for traditional Italian barbershops, Mefisto Gentiluomo is the ultimate gentlemen's cologne.

The clean, cool and fresh qualities of Mefisto Gentiluomo instantly conjure images of straight razors, badger hair brushes and well-lathered shaving cream. A combination of craftsmanship and old-world luxury.

title: Hayat
body:
Taking its name from the Arabic word for life, Hayat is a complex story of the Empedoclean elements of the universe; earth, fire, air and water.

Through the careful selection and precise distillation of its notes, Hayat creates a harmony among the elements that compose it, finding a life-giving equilibrium.

title: Torino21
body:
The first perfume created to mark the Nitto ATP Finals in Turin, Torino 21 captures the adrenaline-filled pre-match atmosphere of a tennis match at the highest level.

The electricity in the air, the concentration of the two adversaries preparing to face off on the court and the baited breath of the waiting crowd. The sense of expectation ahead of watching — and experiencing — something spectacular.

title: La Tosca Hair Mist
body:
The natural ingredients in La Tosca perfumed hair mist make for beautifully nourished hair. Body-enhancing properties and conditioning effects act on keratin, resulting in hair which is soft, light and full of shine and volume.

Containing the same elegant composition of notes as La Tosca perfume, La Tosca perfumed hair mist leaves the hair both looking and smelling divine.

title: Symphonium
body:
Symphonium is a hedonistic ode to harmony and a majestically luxurious scent. A perfume with a truly representative name, it is a symphony of notes arranged to create something beautiful. An elaborate composition of diverse yet complementary ingredients, masterfully combined.

The striking black and white Dalmatian jasper stone that embellishes the Symphonium flacon alludes to the contrast of the notes found within it.

title: Ether
body:
In alchemy, earth, fire, wind and water were the four elements that all matter was believed to be composed of. Then there was the fifth element, ether, a celestial substance that connected the material to the divine.

Ether is a perfume unlike any other, a scent that challenges the senses and rewards those willing to look beyond the familiar.

title: Tony Iommi Deified
body:
Tony Iommi Deified is the second chapter of the collaboration between Black Sabbath’s legendary guitarist and rock composer Tony Iommi and Xerjoff founder Sergio Momo. 

Playing on the phenomenon of palindromes in sound, scent and sensorial sequences, Tony Iommi Deified plays in a loop with no beginning and no end, accompanying the wearer with its omnipresent aura.

title: XXY
body:
Combining traditionally masculine notes with those from the feminine side of the scale, XXY was Xerjoff’s first unisex scent, paving the way for a new direction.

Its flacon is decorated with an intensely blue lapis lazuli stone, which holds great historical importance in the world of art. As the sole ingredient in the ultramarine pigment, it is present in some of the finest works of art from the Renaissance and Baroque periods.

title: Amber Gold & Rose Gold
body:
The Amber Gold & Rose Gold Mixing Experience offers a wealth of olfactory excellence.

Designed to be worn separately or mixed on the skin to create endless combinations, this harmonious set of layering perfumes gives the wearer the freedom to dose and experiment as they please, with total control over the resulting scent.

title: Ouverture
body:
The vibe of Ouverture is instantly perceivable. Warmth, cosiness and relaxation. Soft lighting, logs burning slowly on the fire, a good book in hand and a true sense of contentment at heart.

It is a scent that is experienced as a wave of comfort, imparting a sense of calm and serenity on all those who cross its path.

title: Erba Pura
body:
To inhale the scent of Erba Pura is to wander the narrow streets of a Mediterranean old town at golden hour, the sun intermittently kissing your skin as you pass in and out of shadows cast by remnants of ancient civilisations. So much charm and magic around every corner, waiting to be felt.

As golden hour gives way to sunset and dusk turns to nightfall, Erba Pura remains, exuding a blissful serenity that lingers til the end.

title: Opera
body:
Each perfume in the Vibe collection has its own distinct personality, and Opera’s is unapologetically sophisticated and aristocratic. A single spray of this scent paints a detailed picture and places you right in the middle of it.

An evening show with a black tie dress code. A grand, warmly-lit concert hall lined with red velvet. An audience of impeccably-dressed ladies and gentlemen taking their seats.

The show has begun.

title: Casafutura
body:
Casafutura is a unique perfume that draws inspiration from the Futurist art movement. It seeks to do things differently, exemplified by the symbolic inclusion of diphylleia grayi in its composition.

The white petals of this odourless flower turn completely transparent when wet, in what is a stunning display of beauty and a transformation beyond our usual expectations of the natural world. An artistic statement that represents both Futurism's desire for change and Xerjoff’s philosophy of innovation.

title: Renaissance Deodorant Spray
body:
Renaissance deodorant spray offers a new way to experience the citrusy freshness of the eponymous perfume from the 1861 collection. Drying instantly on the skin thanks to its micronised delivery, the gas-free properties of Renaissance deodorant spray allow the scent to linger while also lending a softness to the skin.

The pump spray design of the deodorant is considerate of even the most sensitive skin, delivering a zesty surge of refreshing energy in the form of a fine mist.

title: Bouquet Ideale Hair Mist
body:
The natural ingredients in Bouquet Ideale perfumed hair mist make for beautifully nourished hair. Body-enhancing properties and conditioning effects act on keratin, resulting in hair which is soft, light and full of shine and volume.

Containing the same composition of warm, spicy notes as the Bouquet Ideale perfume, Bouquet Ideale perfumed hair mist leaves the hair both looking and smelling divine.

title: Lira Hair Mist
body:
The natural ingredients in Lira perfumed hair mist make for beautifully nourished hair. Body-enhancing properties and conditioning effects act on keratin, resulting in hair which is soft, light and full of shine and volume.

Containing the same temptingly gourmand composition of notes as the Lira perfume, Lira perfumed hair mist leaves the hair both looking and smelling divine.

title: Golden Dallah
body:
Irresistibly warm and exotic, Golden Dallah leans into the spiced coffee that is favoured in the Gulf region, and the traditions surrounding it.

Served from an ornate dallah coffee pot, it is offered to guests in the home as a gesture of kindness and goodwill, with the dallah itself a symbol of hospitality and generosity.

title: Bouquet Ideale
body:
Bouquet Ideale traces the origins of the original Casamorati perfume house, building an olfactory bridge between the past and the present.

Based on a perfume originally released by Casamorati in the 19th century, Bouquet Ideale is the outcome of an ambitious challenge that Xerjoff founder Sergio Momo set himself. Upon discovering a sample of the original perfume, which had a largely floral composition, he endeavoured to recreate the scent without using any floral notes.

This warm, soothing scent is a marriage between old and new, and a testament to the art of perfumery.

title: 'Ilm
body:
Taking its name from the Arabic word for knowledge, ‘Ilm is a tribute to the golden age of alchemy.

A seemingly simple, yet meticulously curated fusion of notes, ‘Ilm is a scent for the connoisseurs, those whose comprehension of the craft allows them to appreciate the depth of its beauty.

title: Astaral
body:
The stars have guided man’s exploration of the world and understanding of the universe for centuries. Astaral follows their shining example, revealing undiscovered beauty to those who seek it out.

A captivating perfume with a celestial quality, Astaral blurs the lines between tradition and modernity through the purposeful curation of its notes.

title: Homme
body:
A rich, masculine scent, Homme draws its inspiration from an item of clothing that has transcended its original context and become an embodiment of timeless design — the leather flight jacket.

The flight jacket immediately conjures up images of a rugged adventurer, and Homme provides the olfactory detail that colours the picture. It transports your senses to a specific time and place, even one you’ve never been to, the way only a scent can.

title: Accento Overdose
body:
Through its use of the overdose concept — in which special molecules are used to amplify certain notes — Accento Overdose offers a rich and long-lasting olfactory experience.

It is a hedonistic scent that says no to minimalism and yes to maximalism. It’s about enjoying life's pleasures without worrying about moderation.

title: Wardasina
body:
The word “wardasina” means “little rose” in Arabic, and the elegantly powdery scent of Bulgarian rose is the defining characteristic of this perfume — and the source of its majesty.

Wardasina exudes a very specific type of confidence. The type that comes from knowing what genuine quality is. The type that is cultured and dignified. The type that impresses without actively seeking to, and has no ego attached.

title: Golden Moka
body:
Golden Moka references the cultural significance that coffee holds in the country that birthed the espresso and the cappuccino. Where the moka pot is not only an icon of functional design, but a symbol of national identity.

With its intensity, darkness and creamy quality, Golden Moka recreates the sensation of sipping a freshly-brewed coffee on a sunny Italian morning, while enjoying the shade of a nearby lemon tree.

title: Fars Sample
Dama Bianca
body:
An elegant scent belonging to the soft floral olfactory family, Dama Bianca evokes images of well-manicured garden blooming in springtime, as perfect, cotton-like clouds float gently across the sky above.

Its wearer savours the dreamlike ambience it creates all day long, the envy of those in its wake who experience it only fleetingly.

title: Quattro Pizzi
body:
Quattro Pizzi takes its name from an iconic palace in Palermo that was home to one of the city’s most symbolic and prominent families. The scene where a Sicilian dynasty unfolded, a story of wealth, power, secrecy and sin.

Quattro Pizzi is an irresistible perfume reminiscent of the Belle Époque, intertwining elegance, beauty and nobility with seduction and lust, all set against the dramatic coastal backdrop of northern Sicily.

title: Muse
body:
Muse shares many qualities with the inspirational figures from which it takes its name. A sensual scent with a slight air of mystery, it is a perfume that radiates an intriguing energy.

In this fruity, floral scent, each ingredient is allowed its time as protagonist, taking the nose on a long-lasting journey that all starts with a single spray.

title: Laylati
body:
In Arabic, Laylati means ”my night”, and aptly, this oriental-aromatic perfume conjures up a feeling of nocturnal freedom.

A feeling reminiscent of the haunting, ethereal beauty of observing dusk turn to nightfall high up in the mountains, as the glow of the moonlight illuminates the wild landscape below.

title: Tempest
body:
Tempest was inspired by the Shakespearean play of the same name, in which the protagonist uses alchemical magic to conjure up a great storm.

In Tempest, the alchemy between the notes takes the senses on a voyage and offers a unique olfactory experience to all those who encounter it.

title: Dolce Amalfi
body:
Dolce Amalfi interprets the stunning natural beauty and authentic, old world charm of the Amalfi Coast in scent form.

Reminiscent of both the elegance of the Belle Époque — when the region was a dramatic destination for writers and artists in search of inspiration — and the indulgence of the 50s and 60s, when it became the pinnacle of luxury, attracting glamorous elites from around the world.

title: Italica
body:
Italica draws its inspiration from the deep well that is Italian culture, and from one ingredient in particular that typifies the culinary and artisanal excellence that the south of the country is known for — almond paste.

This traditional ingredient is instantly recognisable in so many southern Italian dessert delicacies, thanks to the smooth, lactonic sweetness that it imparts. That same luxurious quality is what characterises Italica as a quintessentially Italian — and deliciously gourmand — perfume.

title: Torino23
body:
TORINO23 is a scent as graceful as the game of tennis itself. Timeless and traditional, TORINO23 evokes the same class and sophistication that lie at the heart of the sport at the highest level.

Think meticulously-kept lawn clubs with fresh, clean lines, and agile, fluid movements of players in perfectly white polo shirts who make it all look so effortless.

title: Mefisto
body:
With its origins tracing back well over a century, Mefisto is a perfume with timeless appeal. Released in its original guise by Casamorati around the turn of the 20th century, it was created for a female clientele and sold on the promise of its seductive allure.

In its modern-day, unisex form, Mefisto retains this allure, as well as its original Italian character — something that is reflected in its composition.

title: Gran Ballo Hair Mist
body:
The natural ingredients in Gran Ballo perfumed hair mist make for beautifully nourished hair. Body-enhancing properties and conditioning effects act on keratin, resulting in hair which is soft, light and full of shine and volume.

Containing the same fruity-floral composition of notes as the Gran Ballo perfume, Gran Ballo perfumed hair mist leaves the hair both looking and smelling divine.

title: Naxos
body:
Part of the 1861 collection celebrating the unification of Italy, Naxos is an indulgent olfactory tribute to the island of Sicily. An island home to immeasurable natural beauty, immense cultural significance and its own unique form of chaos. A place enriched by the influence of the numerous civilisations who passed through it over the centuries.

Naxos is a rich, ornate fragrance that encapsulates the heat of the sun, the beautiful diversity of Sicily's extraordinary architecture and the feeling one experiences when looking out at the island’s impossibly blue waters, all at once.

title: Elixir
body:
In alchemy, elixirs were substances believed to possess transformative properties, and were often associated with healing, spiritual enlightenment and even immortality.

Inspired by these powerful alchemical concoctions, Elixir’s potency comes from its masterful distillation and concentration into oil form, amplifying the impact of its notes and giving it supreme longevity.

title: Golden Green
body:
Golden Green centres on the cultivation of coffee rather than its consumption, and the aspects of its character that it loses before taking its final form.

The purity of raw, un-roasted beans, still green in colour and with an aroma to match. A long way from the nutty, smoky and instantly recognisable scent of fresh coffee.

title: Jabir
body:
Jābir is a tribute to Arabian perfumery and Jabir ibn Hayyan, the alchemist whose supreme understanding of the world paved the way from alchemy to chemistry.

He saw alchemy not as magic, but as a quest to imitate and replicate the wonders of nature. Inspired by nature, he serves as the ideal muse for Jābir.
